title: Comparative Study of Rosuvastatin/Ezetimib 20/10 mg and Atovastatin/Ezetimib 40/10 mg (TOLERANT Trial)

sections.abstract: the investigators would like to compare the differences between roschvastin and atovastatin in patients who require high-dose statin/ejetimib to undergo a new generation of drug elution stent implantation for cardiovascular disease and maintain LDL cholesterol below 55 mg/dL.
